blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Government Service Insurance System (GSIS) has opened another batch of emergency loans totaling P2.75 billion for members in areas affected by El Niño, crop pests, and a dengue outbreak. In a statement, the GSIS said the P2.75-billion allotment is available to 109,047 active members, as well as old-age and disability pensioners, in Capiz, Camarines Norte, Camarines Sur, Naga City, Agusan del Sur and Las Nieves in Agusan del Norte.
